details.ship_cycle_math: 16 units/ship-cycle base (cargo 32, 2 legs), upkeep 110 (trip 90 + maintenance 20). net = 16*margin - 110, before B3 +8%.

routes.system 2 core: higher than nullglass, so nullglass does not beat it
routes.plate: 120 - inputs at mine cost (2*4+12=20) = 100 per batch per cycle, no hauling per cycle: 1 dross trip feeds 8 batches

details.payback: 1000 / 100 = 10 cycles on mine cost. On forgone raw-sale value (2*18+29=65) value-add is 55, payback 18 cycles: a fabric built after about cycle 8 does not repay before cycle 26. Plus 8 skill points (M1 2, M2 3, F1 3) and permit 600. Fabric is a mid-game investment, not an early win route.
